analysis.summary: Rajputana Biodiesel Limited issued its May 2026 Investor Presentation detailing its financial results, operational capacities, and strategic expansion into compressed biogas and biomass pellets. The company operates two manufacturing plants in Phulera and Meerut with a total capacity of 170 KLPD and maintains supply contracts with major oil marketing companies. Management highlighted the acquisition of Nirvaanraj Energy Private Limited, the formation of Rajputana Agro LLP, and achieving Verra carbon credit certification for its operations. Consolidated annual revenue for FY26 reached 12,202.92 Lakhs with a profit after tax of 1,051.91 Lakhs. Rajputana Biodiesel Limited held its H1 FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting strong operational performance, margin expansion, and progress on capacity enhancements at its Phulera and Meerut units.

guidance.claim: The company aims to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year.
guidance.quote: From April onwards, from coming April onwards, our bids in the OMC tender would be as per our enhanced capacity and we are aiming to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that H2 numbers will be heavier than H1 numbers.
guidance.quote: Our H2 numbers will be heavier than H1 numbers.

demand_outlook.claim: The management noted that the indicative target of blending 5% biodiesel into diesel under the National Biofuels Policy creates a massive industry potential.
demand_outlook.quote: As per National Biofuels Policy of 2018, there is an indicative target of blending 5% biodiesel into diesel. And seeing the target in line, it's a big, big, massive opportunity size in front of us.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Europe has a 14% blending mandate across Europe for using biodiesel.
demand_outlook.quote: If I talk about the European Union region, the demand is even higher as there is a 14% blending mandate across Europe for using biodiesel.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received approvals for establishing two compressed biogas units in Rajasthan.
capex_expansion.quote: As mentioned in our annual report also, for those who have missed the annual report or not gone through it, we have received approvals for establishing two compressed biogas units in the state of Rajasthan.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil work for the compressed biogas project is expected to start by January end.
capex_expansion.quote: By January end, we are looking to start the civil work of this compressed biogas project.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil work for the unit targeting the European Union and GCC marine blending market is planned to begin by January end.
capex_expansion.quote: Last but not the least, we intend to start the civil work of our unit that will be tapping the European Union and the marine blending market of biodiesel in the GCC. By January end, we will be beginning the civil work for this project also.

capex_expansion.claim: The company reported the acquisition of Nirvaanraj Energy Private Limited with an 80 KLPD capacity.
capex_expansion.quote:
Acquisition of Nirvaanraj Energy Private Limited
(80 KLPD capacity)

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that EBITDA margins in the CBG sector are more than 55%-60%.
margins_costs.quote: But trust me, the EBITDA margins are more than 55%-60% in the CBG sector.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the unit economics in Europe allow for almost a 12% to 15% margin on revenues.
margins_costs.quote: So, in terms of unit economics, there is almost a 12%, 15% margin you make on your revenues.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has bid for the highest volume of biodiesel supply ever in its history in the current OMC biodiesel tender.
orders_capacity.quote: I am very delighted to share that the current OMC's biodiesel tender for the period of November to March 2026 is out and really glad to share with you that we have bid the highest volume of biodiesel supply ever in our history.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity at the Phulera and Meerut units has been enhanced by almost 3 to 4 times.
orders_capacity.quote: We have successfully enhanced capacity at our Phulera and Meerut units by almost 3-4 times.

orders_capacity.claim: The company highlighted long-term supply contracts with OMCs including HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL.
orders_capacity.quote: Long-term supply contracts with OMC's (HPCL, BPCL and IOCL)

capital_allocation.claim: Rajputana Biodiesel Limited holds a 99% controlling stake in Rajputana Agro LLP.
capital_allocation.quote: Ownership: Rajputana Biodiesel Limited holds a 99% controlling stake in the LLP.

capital_allocation.claim: The capital raised in the IPO was utilized for immediate working capital needs, technical upgradation, and capacity enhancement.
capital_allocation.quote: We successfully utilized the capital raised in our IPO for immediate working capital needs and technical upgradation along with capacity enhancement.

capital_allocation.claim: The roadmap includes deleveraging of the balance sheet as part of strategic initiatives.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that pricing becomes a point of discussion during policy reviews, which cannot be resolved overnight.
risks_headwinds.quote: The only thing is that sometimes in the review of policy, pricing becomes a point of discussion. And it is a subject which cannot be resolved overnight.

management_commitments.claim: By November end of this year, the company would complete its previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR 100 crores.
management_commitments.quote: By November end of this year, we would be completing our previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR100 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The company is looking to start the civil work of the compressed biogas project by January end.
management_commitments.quote: By January end, we are looking to start the civil work of this compressed biogas project.

management_commitments.claim: Civil work for the unit tapping the European Union and GCC marine blending market will begin by January end.
management_commitments.quote: By January end, we will be beginning the civil work for this project also.

management_commitments.claim: Managing Director Sarthak Soni stated that the company is on track to fulfill its vision and mission in becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy in the Solid, Liquid and Gas segments.
management_commitments.quote: We are absolutely on track to fulfil our vision and mission in becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy in the Solid, Liquid and Gas segments.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
